data.obo_comment:
Consumer product ----------------
### Digital links
- in path: - `01`: GTIN (key) - `22`: consumer product variant (optional) - `10`: batch or lot number (optional) - `21`: serial number (optional) - in query string: - `17`: expiry date (`YYMMDD`, optional) - `15`: best-before date (`YYMMDD`, optional) - `11`: production date (`YYMMDD`, optional) - `3103`: net weight in kg (numer with 3 decimal places, optional)
`GTIN`: Internationally unique product identifier managed by the GS1 Organization

Medical device --------------
A mdeical device is identified by a `UDI` (medical device universal identifier).
A `UDI` is composed of:
- a `UDI-DI`: static _device identifier_ (= the GTIN) - a `UDI-PI`: _production identifiers_
### Digital links syntax
- in path: - `01`: GTIN (key) - `10`: batch or lot number (optional) - `21`: serial number (optional) - in query string: - `17`: expiry date (`YYMMDD`, optional) - `11`: production date (`YYMMDD`, optional) - `8012`: software version (optional)

data.tsl_simplehelp: The UDI as printed under the barcode, AIs in parentheses, e.g. (01)00614141999996(17)271231(10)A1B2C3.
